violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (1): MILK AT 55F OBSERVED IN (4): RAW BURGER AT 65F, RAW RIBS AT 66F, CHICKEN WINGS AT 66F. ALL FOODS WERE IN COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: FOODS LISTED ABOVE DISPOSED OF. ALL TCS FOODS IN (4) WERE DISPOSED OF. COOLERS TAKEN OUT OF USE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. OBSERVED WINE/ALCOHOL STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE HALLWAY AND OFFICE.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PROVIDE SHELVING FOR DRINKS AND ENSURE THEY ARE 6INCHES ABOVE THE FLOOR BY YOUR NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED (1) AT 48F HOLDING FOOD AT 55F. OBSERVED (4) AT ROOM TEMPERATURE (~70F) HOLDING FOODS AT ~65-66F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. BOTH UNITS MUST BE REPAIRED BY OCTOBER 19TH. DO NOT USE THEM FOR STORAGE OF TCS FOODS UNTIL THEY ARE REPAIRED TO HOLD FOOD AT 41F OR BELOW. PLEASE PROVIDE THE INVOICE ON OR BEFORE THE DUE DATE.

violations.observation: OBSERVED A CHEMICAL BOTTLE IN THE HANDWASHING SINK AT THE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: CHEMICAL REMOVED FROM SINK DURING INSPECTION. STAFF RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED PREPARED FOOD ON SITE WITHOUT DATE MARKING INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO SALSA, CUT TOMATO, COOKED PASTA, AND COOKED CHICKEN WINGS
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED AND AGREED TO PUT STICKERS ON ALL FOODS REQUIRING DATE MARKING AFTER THE INSPECTION. HE STATED HE HAS DATE STICKERS FOR EASE OF USE AND WILL BEGIN MARKING BOTH PREPARED FOOD AND OPENED COMMERCIALLY PROCESSED FOODS.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED WINDEX ON THE PREP-LINE AT THE TWO-DOOR PREP-TOP IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: WINDEX RELOCATED. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED A FRUIT FLY KILLER AND RAID IN THE FACILITY.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: BOTH PESTICIDES DISPOSED OF DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: OBSERVED ONLY FOOD MENU TO BE ONLINE. FOOD ITEMS THAT REQUIRE CONSUMER ADVISORY DISCLOSURE AND REMINDER INCLUDE: TIBS, EGGS, SALMON. IF THERE ARE ANY OTHER ITEMS SERVED WITH PARTIALLY RAW OR COMPLETELY RAW INGREDIENTS PLEASE ADD ASTERISK TO THEM.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter.EHS PROVIDED LINK TO DOCUMENT.
